task: Implement a bounded source-only Mavis Phase 3 experiment lifecycle

constraint.statement: Source gates need exact configuration, comparison, verifier, and maintenance evidence before any promotion.
evidence: Mavis plan Phase 3 and promotion rules inspected at omlx-only HEAD; existing maintenance and profile stores inspected before changes.

uncertainty: Full Phase 3 runtime acceptance remains open; this lane is limited to source lifecycle and synthetic tests.
rejected_alternatives: A reviewer string or local file alone cannot authorize promotion; the configured gateway status is rechecked.

requirements.requirement: Freeze baseline and candidate prompt, tool, or retrieval configurations with one changed section.
evidence: Source tests reject altered snapshots and cross-section changes; all three supported kinds are exercised.

requirements.requirement: Require matched held-out evidence and a passing, improved candidate.
evidence: Tests reject mismatched cases, changed output hash, failed mandatory candidate, and insufficient gain.

requirements.requirement: Gate staged promotion on independent gateway review and restore previous configuration on rollback.
evidence: Injected accepted gateway status permits source-level promotion; changed verifier status blocks it; file-only profile promotion is rejected; rollback restores the prior pointer. No live acceptance claimed.

requirements.requirement: Checkpoint and resume experiment jobs while yielding to foreground work.
evidence: Foreground claim is withheld, running job pauses, and a reclaimed job verifies its exact checkpoint hash.

requirements.requirement: Run owned source tests and syntax checks, then document the remaining live Phase 3 acceptance gap.
requirements.command: PYTHONPATH=local-codex/mavis python3 -m unittest discover -s local-codex/mavis/tests -q; python3 -m compileall -q local-codex/mavis/mavis; git diff --check
evidence: 60 Mavis tests passed, syntax compilation passed, and diff check passed; report separates source proof from missing real canary.
